usefulness.rationale: The dossier gives a clear picture of who Bong Joon-ho is: South Korean director of Barking Dogs Never Bite, Memories of Murder, The Host, Mother, Snowpiercer, Okja, Parasite, and Mickey 17, with his Palme d'Or, Oscars, BAFTA, Golden Globe, SAG win, student activism, Yonsei/academy background, and collaborators (Song Kang-ho, Tilda Swinton, Jon Ronson, Kelly Masterson). Understanding is high. Limitations are partially conveyed via contested/claimed/stale status flags, but the dossier does not explicitly state open questions (e.g., conflicting birth-date sourcing, unverified Yonsei graduation year), so remainingQuestions is moderate. Conversation readiness is strong: filmography, awards, working methods (storyboarding, on-set editing), themes, and current activities (Marrakech jury presidency 2025, Mickey 17) are all covered. A few claims overreach their citations, notably a wrong-person attribution (Mersenne Entertainment via an Ahn Nae-sang passage) and stale 'latest/current' framings from 2019 sources.
